summary: Well-executed, fully artifacted preregistered paired study that adhered to the frozen plan and transparently documents that a shared_initial_candidate design produced no opportunity for repair to change outcomes (baseline=guarded=200/200). Reproducibility artifacts, preregistration, disclosure (including master-prompt hash), and treatment of temperature=null are present. The main remaining defect is the References formatting/metadata: ensure conventional IEEE numbered bibliography entries with full bibliographic metadata rather than bare DOI/arXiv/identifier-only items so each cited record can be verified to support the nearby claim.
critical_issues: References appear to include identifier-only entries (DOI/arXiv URLs) in the cited_record_ids; the manuscript must present a conventional IEEE-numbered bibliography with full bibliographic metadata (authors, title, venue, year) for each cited source and ensure each citation in the prose is supported by the referenced record.
required_revisions: Replace any identifier-only reference entries with full IEEE-formatted bibliographic records (authors, title, venue, year) in the References/BibTeX; ensure in-text citations use standard IEEE numeric markers and that each cited record supports the proximate scholarly claim.
optional_revisions: Add one short, explicit sentence in the Introduction or Methods explaining why the shared_initial_candidate design was chosen (operational rationale) and reiterating its interpretational limits.
Consider a brief concluding note about how the observed baseline=100% outcome should inform prospective power assumptions and task-bank design in follow-up runs (optional but helpful for readers).
